checks.requirement: Ordinary reader-facing prose must not expose internal workflow jargon or production TODO language.
Any substantive pre-window artifact must explain the W33 reader-facing trigger or be labeled background/trend analysis.
Any admitted post-cutoff event has exactly one substantive Late Breaking treatment; all other mentions are cross-reference-only. No empty Late Breaking section is created when none qualifies.
Each X Trend Watch item uses 現状 / 未確認 / 注視点 and contains no Candidate Inventory, promotion, carry-over, or next-issue production-management language.
Full evidence/reconciliation provenance remains available in Source Notes/repository artifacts despite simplified reader-facing wording.
The final substantive body section is 今週の総括 / Weekly Synthesis, followed only by References / Source Notes or non-substantive back matter.

closure_policy: Keep GitHub Issue #9 open until W33 rendered PDF demonstrates the remaining Weekly-specific behavior. If no Late Breaking event exists in W33, mark the single-home rule as structurally enforced but not empirically exercised; do not falsely claim that acceptance criterion as exercised by an event that did not occur.
